in crypto, sulle reti segnate «protetta»: in crypto, on the networks marked “protected”, the payment stays in an escrow contract on the blockchain: you release it, or it releases after 14 days, or you freeze it and the platform decides; on the other networks it goes straight to the wallets and cannot be refunded;
Sulle reti segnate «protetta» quando pag: On the networks marked “protected” when you pay, your wallet pays nobody directly: it deposits the whole amount in an escrow contract published on the blockchain, with who gets what already written in it. From there the money can leave in four ways only: you release it, from your area, once the software is installed and working; it leaves on its own after 14 days if you reported nothing (silence counts as confirmation); if you report a problem the payment freezes and the platform decides how much comes back to you and how much goes to the people who did the work; if the platform does not decide within 60 days of the freeze, you take it all back yourself, from your wallet.
La piattaforma è solo l'arbitro: il cont: The platform is only the arbiter: the contract has no owner, cannot be upgraded and has no function to move the money anywhere else. Not even the people running the platform can touch it, other than to send it back to you or on to whoever was written in the deposit. The contract's code is public and verified on the network's explorer; you see its address in the order.
Sulle reti senza contratto il pagamento: On networks without the contract the payment goes from your wallet straight to the recipients' wallets, in a single transaction: the platform never touches it, so it can neither hold nor refund it. You can still open a complaint: it stays on the installer's profile, counts towards their suspension, and the platform asks them to make it right from their wallet, but cannot force them. There, choose installers with installations already confirmed by other customers: you see it on the product page, next to the name.
